purpose: contrastive cosine to all 11 Ulrich stromal centroids on the fib/dec cells at leiden 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2, all on the same 11-column panel so scores are comparable across resolutions and to the published 11-column matrix

provenance.leiden_0.8: recomputed 2026-09-03 from the stored neighbors_scVI_100 graph and verified cell-for-cell against fib_leiden_c7.ipynb's cluster sizes
provenance.leiden_1.0: recomputed here at resolution 1.0 from the same stored neighbors_scVI_100 graph — UNVERIFIED, no prior run to check against
provenance.leiden_1.2: recomputed here at resolution 1.2 from the same stored neighbors_scVI_100 graph — UNVERIFIED, no prior run to check against

CAVEAT: 0.5 and 0.8 have prior runs behind them; 1.0 and 1.2 are computed here for the first time and are unverified. Finer resolutions split cells into smaller groups, so centroids are noisier and margins shrink mechanically — a shrinking margin at higher resolution is not evidence against a match.
